load_pearsonr_metric: load the pearsonr metric using evaluate.load for computing Pearson correlation
compute_pearsonr_correlation: compute the Pearson correlation coefficient between predictions and references
compute_pearsonr_with_pvalue: compute the Pearson correlation coefficient and p-value between predictions and references
launch_gradio_widget: launch a Gradio widget for the pearsonr metric evaluation interface
get_pearsonr_metric_info: get the metric info including description, features, and citation for pearsonr
